get_labels_from_dataset: get all labels from a classification dataset as a stacked torch tensor
get_num_classes_from_dataset: get the number of classes in a dataset by computing the max label value
create_class_indices_mapping: create a mapping from class labels to tensors of dataset indices for each class
split_train_val_datasets: split a training dataset into train and validation subsets with equal class distribution
create_train_dataset_dict: create a dictionary of few-shot training dataset subsets for multiple random evaluation tries
